topic: Reviewing Lithuania rollout specifications and data
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on reviewing the presentation for a full rollout in Lithuania. It was noted that the data provided by Lithuania is incomplete, only partially covering roads and dating from 2016 and 2019. To proceed, the team must cross-reference this existing road data with available screens to ensure adequate coverage. Furthermore, additional data sources may be required for certain parts of Lithuania.

Separately, it was addressed that some sections of the offer are marked as "not included," requiring the team to prepare cost answers in case the client inquires.
decisions: The team agreed to review the presentation content before the scheduled meeting.
action_items: Cross-reference provided Lithuania road data (2016, 2019) with screen locations to assess coverage gaps.
Identify and potentially source additional data for areas of Lithuania not covered by existing datasets.
Prepare cost estimates for items currently marked as "not included" in the offer.
